provenance.coverage: ALL positive stored support entries, not a new dense-vocabulary top-k search
provenance.token_text_semantics: single token decoded with ByteLevel decoder, skip_special_tokens=False; JSON strings preserve whitespace; token_piece preserves raw tokenizer vocabulary spelling
provenance.limitations: Token names do not establish direction semantics or unsafe causality. coef_unit is coefficient on unit J atom, not probability or energy share. No inference, refit, deletion or relabeling.
